o1: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Involved in the apoptotic process; determination of adult lifespan; and serotonin receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Is part of the apoptotic signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in ganglia.
